title: Draft Evidence
description: What was established about one exact ChangeRevision, from exactly which observations. Evidence never carries to another revision: an approval resting on evidence gathered before an edit is an approval of work that was never examined.

inputs.description: The exact observations this read. Id and digest together, so substituting the observed bytes behind a stable id cannot silently change what the evidence rests on.

version.description: Exactly as the producer declared it. Compared byte-for-byte and never parsed as semver.

configuration.description: The digest of the configuration the checks ran under: the same checks under different rules are different evidence.

outcome.description: Five outcomes, because 'no checks ran' and 'checks ran and passed' are different facts. Only `passed` is a reason to proceed; `unavailable` means nothing could ask, which is never evidence that something is fine.

clock_source.description: A conclusion reached against a fixed test clock is a different claim from one reached against real time.
